row.notes: Shared session-state vtable slot 20 (+0xa0) of ~12 states (CinFormationLap, FormationLap, InGamePQ, Cutscene/Location Load/Unload, StoryModeInGamePlaying ...), arg = vehicle index (0xff = none): decides if the HUD may show for the viewed car (camera target is the player car, vehicle status outside masks 0x2045 / 0x14098, pit state outside 0x1e1fe and not 8, game mode +0x1e8 4 or 0x80 or st+0x1011, gate 0x146104178 vcall +0x20, flag +0x31 & 0x20) and ADDS or REMOVES HUD hide reason 0 on the matching player mask (player 1 when the car belongs to the second local player). Addon: the main reason-0 rule; hook it to force the HUD on other cars or while spectating. d7-verify CORRECTION (inverted conditions): vehicle-status masks 0x2045 / 0x14098 must be SET for the HUD to show (none set -> reason 0 added); pit state must be IN mask 0x1e1fe (or > 0x10, or car index >= 0x1b) and != 8; plus viewed car = camera target, game mode +0x1e8 4 or 0x80 or +0x1011, gate 0x146104178, flag +0x31 & 0x20; reason 0 added when any fails, removed otherwise

verify.notes: V2711 Name ok, but polarity of two stated conditions is inverted: vehicle status masks 0x2045/0x14098 must be SET (else HUD hidden), pit-state mask 0x1e1fe must contain the state (state>0x10 or car idx>=0x1b also ok), plus pit state != 8; reason 0 added when any condition fails, removed otherwise
